response.overview: Razak and Rizal are brothers who engage in illegal activities in Kuala Lumpur. Every time Ramadan approaches, they return to their village and help their mother sell grilled chicken at the Ramadan bazaar. They, who are always quarreling, promise to be good throughout Ramadan, but their promise cannot be kept when they fall in love with the same person. They go to great lengths to win Amani's heart. Pak Hassan will allow one of them to go out with Amani, but with various conditions. Both of them strive to meet the conditions set by performing tarawih prayers, helping in communal work, and doing various good deeds in order to win the hearts of Pak Hassan and Amani.
response.title: Ajak Oh Ijal
